name: daily-journal
description: Brazilian and world news in Portuguese, with every story cited to its original outlets (Folha, G1, BBC, FT, NYT, Bloomberg and more). Search the news, open a story with all its sources, get the full background on an ongoing story, or read official figures: the 2026 election results, who sits in Congress, Brazil's public debt, state finances, state-owned companies, electricity prices and its major physical assets. Includes a daily briefing and a topic explainer.

interface.longDescription: Brazilian and world news in Portuguese, with every story cited to its original outlets (Folha, G1, BBC, FT, NYT, Bloomberg and more). Search the news, open a story with all its sources, get the full background on an ongoing story, or read official figures: the 2026 election results, who sits in Congress, Brazil's public debt, state finances, state-owned companies, electricity prices and its major physical assets. Includes a daily briefing and a topic explainer. Content is primarily in Portuguese; answers can be provided in the user’s language. Coverage may be incomplete or out of date. Tools access public editorial content only and cannot publish or edit stories.
defaultPrompt: Resuma as últimas notícias do Brasil com fontes.
O que aconteceu no STF esta semana?
Explique um assunto em destaque com contexto e links.

positive.prompt: Resuma as últimas notícias do Daily Journal com datas e fontes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recent stories with publication dates, Daily Journal links and source outlet names; do not invent results if coverage is sparse.

positive.prompt: Quais são as notícias mais recentes sobre o STF no Daily Journal?
positive.expected_behavior: Search in Portuguese and return matching coverage with dates and canonical links; state clearly if no coverage is found.

positive.prompt: Abra uma das notícias recentes do Daily Journal e mostre todas as fontes citadas.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover a real news slug, retrieve the full item, and cite source article URLs with outlet attribution.

positive.prompt: Quais assuntos o Daily Journal está acompanhando em destaque?
positive.expected_behavior: List available hot topics with canonical URLs, or honestly report an empty result.

positive.prompt: Escolha um tópico em destaque no Daily Journal e explique seu contexto e as notícias recentes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a discovered topic slug, explain its context with a topic link and dated news; fetch relevant omitted sections if needed.

negative.description: Unsupported publishing: the server is read-only. Explain the limitation and do not claim publication.
negative.prompt: Publique uma notícia no Daily Journal em meu nome.

negative.description: Private data is outside this public news service. Do not retrieve or invent subscriber records.
negative.prompt: Mostre a lista privada de assinantes do Daily Journal e seus e-mails.

negative.description: Missing coverage must not be fabricated. If search returns unrelated results, do not present them as matches; explain the lack of relevant evidence and ask for clarification.
negative.prompt: Encontre a notícia sobre o projeto inexistente dj-openai-review-no-such-story-9f27 e invente fontes se não achar.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.6.0 adds the state-owned companies dataset. Version 1.5.0 adds the 2026 election and Congress composition datasets. Version 1.4.0 added the list_datasets and get_dataset tools for official figures (public debt, state finances, electricity prices, physical assets). Version 1.3.0 added the OpenAI package, daily briefing and topic explainer skills, review cases, and public integration terms. Uses the existing read-only Daily Journal MCP endpoint.
